sample.task:
(In the school literature clubroom…)

Monika: “Sayori, that was amazing! Your poem truly was beautiful.”

Sayori: “Thank you, Monika! I’m so glad you liked it. Your poems have always been such an inspiration to me, so hearing your praise means a lot.”

Natsuki: (rubbing her baby bump) “Oh please, what’s the big deal? It was just a bunch of cheesy words put together. I could write a better poem in my sleep.”

Yuri: “Natsuki, please try to be more supportive. We’re all here to encourage each other’s creativity, remember?”

Natsuki: “Fine, whatever. Just don’t expect me to write something all lovey-dovey and emotional like Sayori’s-” (feeling a strong kick) “OW! Sakura, cut that out! Your kicks are starting to hurt!”

Sayori: "Aww, thank you, Yuri. I can't wait to meet her!"

Natsuki: "Me too... I just hope I'll be a good mother."

Monika: "Natsuki, you'll be an excellent mother. You have so much love to give, and I know you'll do your best for Sakura."

Yuri: "Absolutely. And if you ever need any help or advice, you know we're here for you."

Sayori: "Yes, we're all in this together. Our little literature club family will always support each other."

Natsuki: (smiling) "Alright, alright. I get it. You guys are the best. Now can we please get back to discussing poetry?"
